name: Nhiệt điện Phả Lại 1
source_1: MOIT/EVN historical records; PHA LAI annual reports
note: Soviet-built; one of Vietnam's oldest coal plants. Units commissioned sequentially 1983–1986. Capacity sometimes reported as 400 MW (derated). Gross/net unspecified.

name: Nhiệt điện Phả Lại 2
source_1: PHA LAI Thermal Power JSC annual report
note: JBIC-financed. Unit 1 COD 2001, Unit 2 COD 2002.

name: Nhiệt điện Uông Bí 1
note: One of Vietnam's oldest plants; original Soviet-era units. Exact unit configuration and current derated capacity uncertain. Some units may be retired or mothballed. Source = limited public documentation.

name: Nhiệt điện Uông Bí mở rộng
note: Sometimes called Uong Bi 2.

name: Nhiệt điện Ninh Bình
note: Original 4 × 25 MW units Soviet-built, commissioned 1974. Unit 5 (100 MW) added ~2010. Older units may be partially retired/derated. Total capacity variously reported 100–200 MW. Confidence LOW due to age and limited public documentation on current operational status of older units.

name: Nhiệt điện Cẩm Phả 1
note: Also known as Cam Pha TPC Phase 1.

name: Nhiệt điện Cao Ngạn
note: Sometimes reported as 2 × 50 MW. Gross/net unspecified.

name: Nhiệt điện Na Dương 1
note: Burns local lignite.

name: Nhiệt điện Na Dương 2
note: CFB boiler, burns local lignite.

name: Nhiệt điện Nông Sơn
note: At the margin of the 30 MWe threshold. Burns local coal. Limited public documentation.

name: Nhiệt điện Vũng Áng 1
note: One of Vietnam's largest coal plants.

name: Nhiệt điện Vũng Áng 2
source_1: MOIT investment license; Mitsubishi Corp press release (2022)
note: BOT project. Investment decision confirmed 2022. Construction commenced.

name: Nhiệt điện Formosa Hà Tĩnh
source_1: Formosa Ha Tinh Steel Corp filings
note: Captive power plant for Formosa steel complex. Exact configuration uncertain; capacity variously reported 500–650 MW. Primarily self-consumption.

name: Nhiệt điện Nghi Sơn 2
source_1: Marubeni Corp press release (2022); MOIT BOT contract records
note: BOT project. Both units commissioned 2022.

name: Nhiệt điện Thái Bình 2
note: Notorious for massive cost overruns and corruption scandal. Originally expected COD ~2017. Unit 1 commissioned late 2022, Unit 2 in 2023.

name: Nhiệt điện Duyên Hải 1
note: Duyen Hai Power Center, Phase 1. Capacity sometimes reported as 2 × 600 MW nameplate.

name: Nhiệt điện Duyên Hải 2
note: BOT project. Sometimes reported as 600 MW.

name: Nhiệt điện Duyên Hải 3 mở rộng
note: Supercritical technology; sometimes reported as 660 MW.

name: Nhiệt điện Vĩnh Tân 1
source_1: MOIT BOT license; COPI/Vinacomin press releases
note: BOT project. Chinese-financed.

name: Nhiệt điện Vĩnh Tân 2
note: Subject of major environmental protests (2015–2018) over ash disposal.

name: Nhiệt điện Vĩnh Tân 3
note: Originally in PDP VII revised. Removed from PDP VIII; effectively cancelled. BOT project that did not reach financial close.

name: Nhiệt điện Vĩnh Tân 4 mở rộng
Nhiệt điện Long Phú 1
source_1: PVN/PV Power press releases; MOIT reports
note: EPC by Power Machines (Russia); halted due to US sanctions on Russian entities. Construction partially complete but stalled since ~2018. PDP VIII retains it but no restart timeline.

name: Nhiệt điện Long Phú 2
note: BOT project. Tata Power withdrew. Removed from PDP VIII.

name: Nhiệt điện Long Phú 3
source_1: PDP VII revised listed it; PDP VIII removed
note: Never advanced beyond announcement.

name: Nhiệt điện Sông Hậu 1
source_1: PV Power annual report; PVN press releases (2022)
note: Significant delays; originally expected ~2018. Unit 1 COD 2020, Unit 2 COD 2022 (dates approximate).

name: Nhiệt điện Sông Hậu 2
note: BOT project that did not advance. Removed from PDP VIII.

name: Nhiệt điện An Khánh – Bắc Giang
note: Small coal plant. Limited public documentation.

name: Nhiệt điện Thăng Long
note: Privately developed.

source_1: Jaks Resources Berhad Bursa Malaysia filings (2020–2021)
note: Also known as Hai Duong 1. Chinese-financed BOT.

name: Nhiệt điện Mông Dương 2
source_1: AES Corp annual report / SEC filings
note: BOT project. AES sold its stake to a consortium in 2021.

name: Nhiệt điện Vân Phong 1
source_1: Sumitomo Corp press release; MOIT investment license
note: BOT project. EPC awarded. Under construction.

name: Nhiệt điện Quảng Trạch 1
note: Under construction.

name: Nhiệt điện Quảng Trạch 2
note: Listed in PDP VIII but no EPC or financing confirmed.

name: Nhiệt điện Nam Định 1
note: BOT project that did not advance.

note: Private project; stalled for years. Not in PDP VIII. Effectively shelved/cancelled.

name: Nhiệt điện Kiên Lương 1
note: Long-delayed private project. Removed from PDP VIII.

note: Never advanced.

name: Nhiệt điện An Khánh 1

name: Nhiệt điện Lục Nam
note: Reported in some industry trackers. Cannot verify with primary source.

name: Nhiệt điện Phú Mỹ 1
note: Part of Phu My Power Center. Burns Cuu Long Basin gas. Capacity sometimes reported as 1,070–1,090 MW.

name: Nhiệt điện Phú Mỹ 2.1
note: Extension of Phu My complex. Capacity variously reported 400–480 MW.

name: Nhiệt điện Phú Mỹ 2.1 mở rộng
Nhiệt điện Phú Mỹ 2.2
source_1: EDF press releases; MOIT BOT license
note: Vietnam's first gas-fired BOT. 2-on-1 CCGT configuration.

name: Nhiệt điện Phú Mỹ 3
source_1: BP press releases; MOIT BOT license
note: BOT project. Ownership transferred over time.

name: Nhiệt điện Phú Mỹ 4
note: Part of Phu My complex. Capacity sometimes reported differently.

name: Nhiệt điện Bà Rịa
note: Vietnam's first gas turbine plant. Originally OCGT; some units may have been converted or supplemented. Total capacity variously reported 327–389 MW. Configuration uncertain.

name: Nhiệt điện Nhơn Trạch 3
source_1: PV Power press releases (2023–2024); PDP VIII
note: Vietnam's first LNG-to-power project to reach construction. Will use imported LNG via Thi Vai LNG terminal.

name: Nhiệt điện Nhơn Trạch 4
source_1: PV Power press releases; PDP VIII
note: Paired with Nhon Trach 3; same LNG supply.

name: Nhiệt điện Ô Môn 1

name: Nhiệt điện Ô Môn 2

name: Nhiệt điện Ô Môn 3

name: Nhiệt điện Ô Môn 4
note: Planned LNG-fired CCGT. No developer confirmed.

name: Nhiệt điện Thủ Đức
note: Old gas turbine plant. Capacity and current operational status uncertain; may be partially retired.

name: Nhiệt điện Cần Thơ
note: Gas turbine plant. Limited public documentation.
